thread:
nina (Design): quick ping — new variant of the rollout history timeline. this one emphasizes time labels and adds an inline 'replay' affordance. figma: https://figma.mock/timeline-replay-1

omar (Product): I like the inline replay idea for debugging sessions. question: does replay mean re-deploy or just open a detailed view? we should avoid ambiguity.

nina (Design): prototype intention is 'open detailed historical view' not an automatic redeploy. we can use hover tooltip 'Open deployment details' and a confirmation for any redeploy action.

luke (Eng Runtime): can implement tooltip easily. note: we already have endpoint `/api/deployments/:id/replay` but it triggers a rerun on CI; definitely want a confirmation flow if exposed. keep it read-only here.

maya (Accessibility): a11y notes: 1) timeline nodes need clear hit-targets (>= 44px). 2) tooltips should be accessible via keyboard focus and use aria-describedby. 3) 'replay' affordance should not be worded as a verb that triggers redeploy, maybe 'View details' or 'Open snapshot'.

nina (Design): switched label to 'Open snapshot' and added a clarifying tooltip. also increased node hit area and added focus-visible states.

omar (Product): nice. one more ask: add a quick filter for 'show only rollbacks' and 'show only canary changes' — helps support triage. UI idea: small pill filters above timeline.

luke (Eng Runtime): backend: we can surface `change_type` on each deployment (`ROLLBACK`, `CANARY_ADJUST`, `PROMOTE`) so client can filter without extra calls. will add to the page payload.

maya (Accessibility): for the pills, ensure aria-pressed state and keyboard toggling. also provide a live region announcement when filter applied: 'Showing rollbacks only'.

nina (Design): added pill states and aria-live region. reworked the timeline legend to include small icons for change_type.

ui-bot: pushed branch `design/timeline-snapshot-pills` to staging at 2024-11-11T11:00:05Z

luke (Eng Runtime): added mock payload snippet: `{"deployments":[{"id":"d_123","version":"v3.0.1","change_type":"ROLLBACK","ts":"..."}, ...]}`

omar (Product): love it. schedule usability check with support next week. nina, can you add a tiny onboarding tooltip for first-time users explaining 'Open snapshot' vs 'replay'?

nina (Design): on it — will add and keep it dismissible with a 'don't show again' toggle stored in localStorage. will ensure tooltip is dismissible via keyboard.

maya (Accessibility): check keyboard dismiss and persistent preference accessible via account settings too. don't rely only on localStorage for cross-device settings.

nina (Design): good catch — will add account setting option in the settings panel mock. thanks! :pray:
